timestamp_as_written: ISO 8601 with '+00:00' suffix, but the clock values are BROKER SERVER TIME (MT5 returns server-time epoch)
server_offset_rule: UTC+2 standard time, UTC+3 from the last Sunday of March to the last Sunday of October (EU DST rules, NOT America/New_York)
to_utc: strip '+00:00', treat as naive server time, tz_localize('Europe/Athens'), tz_convert('UTC')  ==  UTC = server_time - offset

verification_2026_09_29.method: offset = file time of the dominant 1-minute bar at US 08:30 America/New_York releases minus their true UTC time (GBPUSD only)
